items.description: These are projects and lists of projects you can contribue to.

items.title: LanguageTool
items.description: LanguageTool is an Open Source proofreading tool.

items.title: Owncast
items.description: A self-hosted livestreaming video and chat server that allows you to build experiences similar, but not limited to, big tech owned services. A great project for those interested in design, media, documentation, tutorials or community engagement.

items.title: Oppia
items.description: Oppia is an online learning tool that enables anyone to easily create and share interactive activities.

items.title: Awesome App Ideas
items.description: A list of app ideas. You can add your own app ideas. Non-Programmers can create app ideas for programmers looking through the list to solve.

items.title: swag-for-dev
items.description: 😎👕🧦 A list of swag opportunities for developers.

items.title: The Sourdough Framework
items.description: An opportunity to share your bread / sourdough recipes!

items.title: The Turing Way
items.description: A series of open source guides about data science and AI. Contributors can add to new and ongoing chapters, work on translation efforts, contribute to infrastructure maintenance work within the project, and more.

items.title: Awesome Fantasy
items.description: A list of fantasy books and TV-series that anyone can contribute to.

items.title: DevJoke
items.description: #DevJoke. Submit a PR if you know a good dev joke.

items.title: Cloud Native Glossary
items.description: CNCF Glossary explains cloud-native concepts and the terminologies involved in that ecosystem in simple language and does not require any prior technical background to grasp them. Individuals can start contributing to it by localizing/translating or modifying current terms or proposing new terms.

items.title: LaTeX Gboard Dictionary
items.description: ⌨ Add shortcuts to a Gboard dictionary to allow Unicode to be typed with simple shortcuts on Android ⚡.

items.title: PetMe
items.description: A platform for finding homes for animals in need, always open to contributions.

items.title: List of all the awesome lists
items.description: A collection of URLs. Excellent way to send your first pull-request.

items.title: Open Drinks
items.description: Submit drink recipes.

items.title: Data Science Notes
items.description: Share notes across topics in data science such as mathematics, visualization, and modeling!

items.title: CheatSheets
items.description: Cheat sheet documentation project that allows contributors to add and reference most common commands for systems we know and love in a single place.

items.title: Open Source Practice and Resources
items.description: Make your first pull request with beginner friendly project, just add relevant resources which you find beneficial and adding values to your learning journey💪.

items.title: List of Open Source projects
items.description: by corporations, Higher Education Institutions, and governments

items.title: Pizza Verse
items.description: A repository for sharing pizza recipes, facts, regional pizzas, and traditional foods from your home country. Non-programmers can add recipes or food facts by modifying Markdown files as explained in their Contribution Guidelines.

items.title: Awesome Animal Care
items.description: List of curated, practical information resources to care for dogs, cats, fishes, horses, parrots and others.

items.title: AI Language Partner
items.description: Local-first Japanese speaking practice app for Korean learners. Non-programmers can improve Korean/Japanese docs, review beginner dialogue naturalness, and add learner notes through first-timers-only issues.

items.description: Learn CSS Flexbox while playing!

items.description: 👶 Tech explained like you're five!

items.description: 🔥 A curated list of content worth sharing to help you get inspired! ⚡️.

items.title: GitHub for Non-Programmers
items.description: Guide on using GitHub for workflows other than programming.

items.title: DX Knowledge Base
items.description: Open source Knowledge Base filled with articles about Developer Experience and related topics like software creation process and team management.

items.title: Basic Github commands
items.description: This repository serves as a comprehensive guide to the fundamental commands of Git. Whether you are a beginner or looking to refresh your knowledge, this repository provides clear explanations and practical examples of essential Git commands. Contributors can enhance this project by adding new chapters or expanding ongoing ones, working on translation efforts to make the content accessible to a broader audience, providing feedback and suggestions for better documentation.
